Mali.title: Mali: 4,880 terrorists put out of action in five months, the army reveals the scale of operations
Mali.summary: The Malian army continues its offensive against armed groups. During his monthly press briefing on Friday, October 23, 2026, Colonel-Major Bakary Bocar Maiga, Director of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces, took stock of the operations carried out by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) According to this report, 4,880 fighters of terrorist armed groups were put out of action between May and October 20, and more than 162 bases, 315 pick-ups and 1,300 motorcycles were destroyed.

Mali.title: PRESS BRIEFING: DIRPA reports 4,880 fighters of the Armed Terrorist Groups put out of action during the period from May to 20 October 2026
Mali.summary: Faithful to its meeting with the media, the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA) held its traditional monthly press briefing, this Friday, October 23, 2026, at its premises. The meeting was moderated by the Director of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces, Colonel-Major Bakary Bocar MAIGA, in the presence of an audience of journalists and media professionals .

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Security situation: More than 4,880 terrorists neutralized and 162 bases destroyed by FAMa
Mali.summary: Bamako, 23 October (AMAP) Faced with the press, Friday, 23 October 2026, at the premises of the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), Colonel-Major Bakary Bocar Maiga presented the results of the operations carried out by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). It reported more than 4,880 terrorists neutralized and 162 bases destroyed over the entire period from May to 20 October .

Mali.title: Press briefing: the FAMa announce more than 4,880 neutralized terrorist fighters
Mali.summary: The Director of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), Colonel-Major Bakary Bocar Maïga, presented, on October 23, 2026, the results of the operations of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) According to the figures provided, more than 4,880 terrorist fighters were put out of action and 162 bases destroyed during the period from 10 September to 20 October.

Mali.title: Bandiagara: one dead and one injured in an attack in Danlekanda
Mali.summary: One dead and one wounded by gunfire, this is the result of an attack perpetrated Thursday, October 22 by unidentified armed individuals against the village of Danlekanda, in the commune of Muétoumou, Bandiagara circle. The injured person was on his way to the Bandiagara referral health center. Last week, the village of Dôolo, in the same commune, recorded three deaths in another attack .

Mali.title: Speculations on Mali-Algeria border cooperation
Mali.summary: Recent strikes by Algeria against illegal gold miners in the south of the country feed the comments of Malian netizens who want to see the beginning of military cooperation in the border area, a traditional retreat base for fighters of the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) . Conversely, Tuareg Fla sympathizers condemn this possible future rapprochement and resurrect old distrust of Algeria.

Mali.title: Mali-Qatar: security cooperation at the centre of exchanges
Mali.summary: The Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine, received in audience, on 22 October 2026, Qatar's new ambassador to Mali, Ahmed Turki A. A. Alsobai.

Mali.title: Mali – Türkiye: Ambassador Efe CEYLAN received by Minister Daoud Aly MOHAMMEDINE to consolidate defence cooperation
Mali.summary: COOPERATION MALI TÜRKİYÉ: TOWARDS A STRENGTHENING OF the PARTNERSHIP IN the FIELD OF SECURITY The strengthening of security cooperation between Mali and Türkiye was at the heart of the audience granted, this Thursday, October 22, 2026, by the Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly MOHAMMEDINE, to His Excellency Mr. Efe CEYLAN, Ambassador of the Republic of Türkiyé in Mali .

Mali.title: Mali Army, Russian Fighters Accused of Civilian Killings
Mali.summary: Human Rights Watch has accused Mali's armed forces and Russia-controlled Africa Corps of committing serious abuses against civilians in the central Mopti region during renewed fighting. The organisation said an apparent military drone strike on September 16 killed eight civilians and injured at least six others in Guélédié village. Witnesses reported that the strike hit an area where residents had gathered to access satellite internet, although armed fighters linked to al-Qaeda were reportedly present in the village.

Mali.title: Mali – Qatar: General Daoud Aly Mohammedine and the Qatari diplomat discuss security cooperation
Mali.summary: MALI QATAR: TOWARDS STRENGTHENING SECURITY COOPERATION The Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly MOHAMMEDINE, received in audience, this Thursday, October 22, 2026, His Excellency Ahmed Turki A. A. ALSOBAI, new Ambassador of the State of Qatar in Mali .

Mali.title: Mali: Army, Russia's 'Africa Corps' Commit New Abuses
Mali.summary: Nairobi — Unlawful Drone Strike, Torture of Civilians in Mopti Region Mali's armed forces and the allied Russia-controlled Africa Corps have committed new atrocities against civilians in central Mali during renewed fighting, Human Rights Watch said today. On September 16, 2026, an apparent military drone strike in Guélédié village, Mopti region, killed eight civilians and injured at least six others.

Mali.title: Mali: More than forty civilians killed on Sunday by armed men
Mali.summary: Mali : plus d'une quarantaine de civils tués dimanche par des hommes armés More than 40 civilians were killed on Sunday in attacks carried out by armed men in the Ménaka region of northeastern Mali, causing population displacements, several security, local and civil society sources told AFP on Monday. These bloody attacks, carried out by armed men arriving on motorcycles, targeted, according to these sources, several camps belonging mainly to the Daoussahak community, from which the armed movement "Movement for the Salvation of Azawad" (MSA), close to the junta in power in Bamako, originates.

Mali.title: Mali: more than forty civilians killed Sunday by armed men, according to security and local sources
Mali.summary: More than 40 civilians were killed on Sunday in attacks by armed men in the Menaka region of northeastern Mali, causing population displacement, several security, local and associative sources told AFP on Monday. These bloody attacks, carried out by armed men arrived on motorcycles, targeted, according to these sources, several camps belonging mainly to the Daoussahak community, from which the armed movement "Movement for the Salvation of Azawad" (MSA), close to the junta in power in Bamako, came.

Burkina Faso.title: Quarterly increase in the colours of the SDS: Burkinabe Customs at the rendezvous of patriotic duty
Burkina Faso.summary: This Friday, October 23, 2026, the Directorate General of Customs hosted the quarterly ceremony of raising the national colours of the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and the Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP). This solemn meeting, marked by patriotism and brotherhood of arms, was held in a context marked by the commemoration of the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina/Solidarity: A member of the diaspora provides support to widows and orphans who are victims of the war
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina/Solidarity: A member of the diaspora provides support to widows and orphans victims of the war ASVOVIG staff and donors In a show of solidarity with families affected by the war, Abdoul Dramane Guinko, a member of the Burkinabe diaspora, donated food to the Agency for the Support of Widows, Orphans and Victims of War (ASVOVIG), this Friday, October 23, 2026 in Ouagadougou Composed of rice, spaghetti and oil, this donation aims to support the families of war victims.

Burkina Faso.title: ‎Tenkodogo: Water and forest agents capture a crocodile near a chicken coop and release it into the dam
Burkina Faso.summary: Tenkodogo: Water and forestry officers capture a crocodile near a chicken coop and release it into the dam A crocodile lurking near a chicken coop in a courtyard in the Gommisi neighborhood, opposite the Tenkodogo Gendarmerie Group, was captured without incident on Thursday, October 22, 2026, and then released into the city dam . According to the Burkina news agency that reports the information, it was a resident who gave the alert to the competent services after seeing the reptile in the concession.

Niger.title: illabéri: the Minister of Equipment and Infrastructure visits the rehabilitation site of the Farié-Téra axis
Niger.summary: Tillabéri, Oct 23 (ANP) – The Minister of Equipment and Infrastructure, Colonel-Major Salissou Mahaman Salissou carried out, this Friday, October 23, 2026, a field visit to the rehabilitation site of the Farié-Téra road as well as at the Garbougna structure. The purpose of this visit was to inquire about the progress of the work and to assess the results obtained .

Niger.title: Defense: In the field of military operations, the SDF continues to maintain pressure on armed terrorist groups
Niger.summary: Despite the relative lull observed recently in the fight against security threats, the defense and security forces (FDS) remain mobilized on the various fronts of military operations where they continue to maintain pressure against armed terrorist groups (AGT) and other organized criminal groups .

Niger.title: Algeria and Niger sign 'Memorandum of Understanding' to strengthen military cooperation
Niger.summary: Since the reconciliation at the beginning of the year between the President of Niger, Abdourahamane Tiani, and that of Algeria, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, Niamey and Algiers have not left each other: in the space of a month, this is the second time that leaders of the armies of the two countries have met. A new exchange that ended this week with the signing of a memorandum of understanding on Algerian-Nigerian military cooperation In addition to the interview with his Algerian counterpart for Defence, Said Chengriha, the Nigerien Minister Salifou Modi was also received by President Tebboune.

Niger.title: Tillabéri: the Minister of Equipment notes the progress of the work on the Farié-Téra road
Niger.summary: The Minister of Equipment and Infrastructure, Colonel-Major Salissou Mahaman Salissou, carried out this Friday, October 23, a field visit on the Fari-Tera road, in the Tillabéri region, to assess the progress of the rehabilitation work on this road and to note the state of a crossing work carried out in Garbou Gna for the benefit of the populations Accompanied by the Governor of the Tillabéri region, Colonel Maina Boukar, the Secretary General of the Governorate, officials of the Defence and Security Forces (FDS), the Prefect of the Department of Gothèye, as well as ministerial officials and departmental and…

Niger.title: Africa: Algeria and Niger sign "a memorandum of understanding" to strengthen their military cooperation
Niger.summary: The rapprochement between Algeria and Niger continues. After the visit of the President and the Prime Minister of Niger, the Minister of Defence was welcomed on 21 October in Algiers. With his Algerian counterpart, they signed a military agreement to strengthen security cooperation between the two countries This meeting comes barely two months after a mutiny in Niamey against the power of President Abdourahamane Tiani who has since received military support from Algiers.

Niger.title: Algeria and Niger sign 'Memorandum of Understanding' to strengthen military cooperation
Niger.summary: Algeria and Niger sign "a memorandum of understanding" to strengthen their military cooperation The rapprochement between Algeria and Niger continues. After the visit of the President and the Prime Minister of Niger, the Minister of Defence was welcomed on 21 October in Algiers. With his Algerian counterpart, they signed a military agreement to strengthen security cooperation between the two countries This meeting comes barely two months after a mutiny in Niamey against the power of President Abdourahamane Tiani who has since received military support from Algiers.

Niger.title: Algeria-Niger ‘security pact’: What’s behind Algiers’ military push into the Sahel?
Niger.summary: Algiers and Niamey deepen military cooperation as army chief Saïd Chengriha and defence minister Salifou Mody sign an agreement aimed at strengthening security ties amid regional threats.

Niger.title: Algeria-Niger: a military agreement that confirms the return of Algiers to the Sahel
Niger.summary: Algeria and Niger signed a memorandum of understanding on military cooperation on the occasion of the visit to Algiers of the Nigerien Minister of Defence, General Salifou Mody. This rapprochement comes in a context of recomposition of security alliances in the Sahel, where Algiers seeks to consolidate its influence with the countries of the Alliance of Sahelian States (AES) Algeria and Niger have taken a new step in their security rapprochement with the signing, on Wednesday 21 October 2026 in Algiers, of a memorandum of understanding on military cooperation.
